sources.independence_basis: Separate security organizations publish distinct technical accounts of the same July2023 zkSync EraLend exploit. Both reviewed bodies identify this exact execution and explain stale-reserve read reentrancy; neither attributes its mechanism account to the other. This is Codex public-source consensus, not independent human review or proof of independent investigative methods.

identity_basis.review: Beosin explicitly lists this hash under Attacking Transactions in its zkSync EraLend analysis; Olympix explicitly prints the identical Transaction Hash within its zkSync EraLend section. Beosin lists the matching attacker and destination attack contract; the official chain324 transaction and receipt independently bind execution identity. No other roundup transaction is included.
